metadata.description: A collection of AI agent skills for managing media libraries, downloading content, and automating workflows.

plugins.name: media-server-skills
plugins.description: Skills for interacting with Plex, Jellyfin, Audiobookshelf, and Kavita media servers - list libraries, search media, manage metadata, and trigger rescans.

plugins.name: torrent-skills
plugins.description: Skills for searching and downloading torrents from nyaa.si (anime), YTS/YIFY (movies), and managing downloads via qBittorrent.

plugins.name: ebook-skills
plugins.description: Skills for EPUB metadata management, cover art embedding, and downloading ebooks from Library Genesis.

plugins.name: audiobook-skills
plugins.description: Skills for audiobook library management, cover art downloading, metadata embedding, and AudiobookBay/Audiobookshelf integration.

plugins.name: ai-tools
plugins.description: Skills for programmatically using GitHub Copilot SDK from Python applications.
